source_findings.finding: Before every single-dispatch CB the CPU poisons the current provider output, encodes, commits and waits. The timestamp gap is not a direct CPU phase measurement.
After GPU completion all timing arms run complete score-vs-capture and score-vs-TILED word-diff loops plus a visible/causal/poison scan. No host phase wall timestamps exist.
Timing JSON creation performs an additional memcmp-to-TILED, which may exit early for actual layer2, and one complete SHA256 of the output for every arm.
Each JSON record is serialized, written and flushed before the next CB.

Fixed A1/B/A2 confounds slot and predecessor. Every formal A1 follows the same control provider; B follows A1; A2 follows candidate B. A1 versus A2 is not an independently randomized time-drift estimator.
Layer boundaries perform complete post-input dumps and hashes; boundary gaps must not be pooled with ordinary gaps for host-cost attribution.

limitations: No GPU frequency, cache counters, power, thermal or CPU-phase clocks were recorded; no such root cause is proven.
Formal A1/A2 predecessor identities are determined by the fixed arm order and are not separately identifiable from position.
Current GPUStartTime minus previous GPUEndTime includes CPU wait/validation/serialization/poison/encode plus driver/queue delay; it is not direct validation time.
Correlations are descriptive and unadjusted, with nine formal samples per arm/group; they are not causal estimates or new acceptance gates.
Paired contrasts do not replace the frozen ratio-of-medians drift gate, drop samples or reopen the failed cohort.

aaa.purpose: Measure slot/sequence and host-processing bias with identical GPU work before any candidate retest.
aaa.schedule: Independently for each control use identical PSO, input buffers, output buffer and full original validation/SHA policy for all three labeled slots. Freeze one cohort and warmup/formal counts before GPU work.
measurements: All GPU start/end timestamps and monotonic host boundaries for poison, encode, commit/wait, full validation, extra memcmp, SHA, JSON serialize/write/flush.
Retain full phase1 and final outputs, ordered Top512 and input/guard witnesses. Record previous provider, group, order and slot.
aaa.decision: Diagnostic only; no candidate adoption or retrospective gate change.

balanced_order.purpose: Separate candidate/control contrasts from position and immediate-predecessor effects.
balanced_order.schedule: Freeze all six permutations of labels A1,B,A2, with A1/A2 bound to the exact same control PSO/output. Use a multiple of six formal groups, e.g. twelve, and freeze the seed/order before execution.
balanced_order.additional_transition_probe: For predecessor attribution explicitly balance conditioning/test pairs AA,AB,BA,BB; the old AAB multiset has no within-group BB transition.
balanced_order.controls: Treat actual default and TILED independently on every layer; do not average a failed group away.
balanced_order.host_factor: An equalized-validation variant must be a separate frozen diagnostic factor: full-scan comparisons plus equal SHA/log work per slot. Retain complete raw correctness and do not mix its timings with the old driver.
balanced_order.decision: Identity and correctness precede timing; keep every sample. Diagnostic success neither proves full-model speed nor rescues r2.

metric_semantics.gpu_timestamp_span: Elapsed range from first recorded CB GPUStartTime to last recorded CB GPUEndTime.
metric_semantics.active_fraction: Sum of recorded CB GPUStart/End spans divided by that range; not hardware GPU active residency, occupancy or device utilization.
metric_semantics.inter_cb_gap: Next recorded GPUStartTime minus prior recorded GPUEndTime; host processing, queue and driver causes are not separately timestamped.
